<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate initially, then mirror the opponent’s previous action. This preserves mutual cooperation, punishes sustained defection, and can recover cooperation after isolated defections rather than permanently switching to low-payoff mutual defection.
</DESCRIPTION>
